findings.message: The fmt chunk states 44100 Hz, but the AC-3 stream has a sampling rate of 48000 Hz and its bursts take a link rate of 48000 Hz.

The data holds 5 data-bursts of IEC 61937 with AC-3 frames, as S/PDIF passthrough writes them, not samples; the fmt chunk describes the carrier (16 bits, 2 channels at 44100 Hz), and the stream is read as AC-3.
